description.narrative: (Tanzania): .Sera Bora ("Better Policy") will continue to focus on research and analytical work in the food security sector, as well as Government of Tanzania (GOT) institutional capacity building. Using FY 2022 funds USAID will undertake research to identify emerging analytical needs and support the national nutrition policy formulation process. This is aimed at generating recommendations for mitigating the effects of climate change, COVID-19 pandemic, and the Russia-Ukraine war on Tanzania's agriculture and nutrition sectors. Funds will also be utilized to strengthen the effectiveness and communication of nutrition policies... .
